definitions.explanation: Food cooked by grilling, broiling, or roasting over direct heat. A fundamental Japanese cooking method.
Items made of fired clay, including pottery and porcelain.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{焼|や}き{物|もの}は{魚|さかな}です。
{焼|や}き{物|もの}が{一番|いちばん}{好|す}きな{料理|りょうり}です。
examples.english: Grilled dishes are my favorite type of cooking.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}き{物|もの}は{日本料理|にほんりょうり}の{基本的|きほんてき}な{調理法|ちょうりほう}の{一|ひと}つです。
examples.english: Grilled dishes are one of the fundamental cooking methods in Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: {居酒屋|いざかや}では{焼|や}き{鳥|とり}や{焼|や}き{魚|ざかな}などの{焼|や}き{物|もの}がよく{注文|ちゅうもん}されます。
examples.english: At izakaya, grilled dishes like yakitori and grilled fish are often ordered.

examples.japanese: {炭火|すみび}で{焼|や}いた{焼|や}き{物|もの}は{香|かお}りがよく、{家庭|かてい}のグリルとは{違|ちが}う{味|あじ}わいが{楽|たの}しめます。
examples.english: Charcoal-grilled dishes have a wonderful aroma and offer a flavor that is different from a home grill.

examples.japanese: この{焼|や}き{物|もの}の{茶碗|ちゃわん}はとてもきれいです。
examples.english: This pottery tea bowl is very beautiful.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{焼|や}き{物|もの}は{海外|かいがい}でも{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: Japanese pottery is popular overseas too.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}き{物|もの}の{窯|かま}を{見学|けんがく}しました。
{祖母|そぼ}が{集|あつ}めていた{焼|や}き{物|もの}の{茶碗|ちゃわん}を{大切|たいせつ}にしています。
examples.english: I treasure the pottery tea bowls that my grandmother collected.

examples.japanese: この{地方|ちほう}では{昔|むかし}から{焼|や}き{物|もの}が{盛|さか}んで、{今|いま}でも{多|おお}くの{窯元|かまもと}が{伝統的|でんとうてき}な{技法|ぎほう}を{守|まも}っています。
examples.english: Pottery has been thriving in this region since long ago, and many kilns still preserve traditional techniques today.

notes:
{焼|や}き{物|もの} has two main meanings:

**1. Grilled/roasted food** ({焼|や}く = to grill)
Common dishes:
- {焼|や}き{魚|ざかな} (grilled fish)
- {焼|や}き{鳥|とり} (yakitori)
- {焼|や}き{肉|にく} (yakiniku)
- {卵焼|たまごや}き (omelet)

**2. Pottery/ceramics** (fired in a kiln)
Famous types:
- {有田焼|ありたやき} (Arita ware)
- {九谷焼|くたにやき} (Kutani ware)
- {清水焼|きよみずやき} (Kiyomizu ware)

Context determines the meaning. In food contexts, it means grilled dishes; in art/craft contexts, it means pottery.

Related cooking methods:
- {煮物|にもの} (simmered)
- {揚|あ}げ{物|もの} (fried)
- {蒸|む}し{物|もの} (steamed)
